content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not use a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary as its ground, nor does it treat a two-sense verse as open.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"none","why":"The judge's UNDERDETERMINED rests on the dropped curse limb and absence of a live link, not on any single verse failing to state a link or its contrary."}
